title: Art Pet Identity
description: Art-direction identity of a bonded pet or creature (data/art/pets/<group>/<slug>.json). A test-bed pet (testBed:true, Angel Primes) has no gameplay card; its look is the single home for what the creature looks like, and a scene's companion piece places it. bondedTo must point at a hero identity whose profile.pet points back.

kind.description: The creature (lion, fairy, snow leopard ...); never a dragon in Angel Primes

size.description: How big it is next to its angel, for placing it in a scene

look.description: What it looks like: coat, markings, eyes, the one detail that ties it to its element

temperament.description: Its character and how it behaves around the angel

scenePlacement.description: Where it sits or moves in a signature scene (the companion piece repeats this)
